create_intent_slot_decoder: create an IntentSlotModelDecoder with config, document and word input dimensions, and output dimensions
build_intent_slot_config: build an IntentSlotModelDecoder Config with use_doc_probs_in_word, doc_decoder, and word_decoder settings
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass on document and word tensors to get intent logits and slot predictions
review_forward_dense: review the forward method to concatenate optional dense features with document and word inputs
get_decoder_modules: get the list of doc_decoder and word_decoder nn.Module instances from the decoder
